name: rentfrontend
description: 🏡 Manage rental properties effortlessly with this React.js frontend, offering users a responsive interface for browsing, listing, and managing spaces.

paragraphs: The rentfrontend project is a Rental Space Management System. This full-stack web application allows users to list, discover, and manage rental properties. Designed for ease of use, it combines a React frontend with a Django REST Framework backend, and stores data in Neon (Postgres) for reliability and performance.
features: User-Friendly Interface: Easy to navigate and manage.
Property Listings: List your rental properties and browse available options.
Secure Authentication: Use secure JWT authentication for your account.
Payment Integration: Accept payments through Stripe for hassle-free transactions.
Responsive Design: Perfect for use on both desktop and mobile devices.
